verdict.rationale: Bruno's own docs say you can write assertions and test suites, and they describe a dedicated Tests tab and post-response JavaScript scripting. That establishes the core test-assertion capability. However, the pack never explicitly shows assertions against response status, body, or headers. missing for 10: explicit documentation of status-code, response-body and response-header assertion syntax or examples, independent/hands-on corroboration of assertions working.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write test assertions against response status, body, and headers

citations.quote: Write assertions and test suites, and automate runs with data-driven testing.
Open the Tests tab, click the AI icon, and describe what to assert. Bruno generates test code that you can review before accepting.
Pre-request and post-response JavaScript — the `bru` API, request chaining, and libraries.
